title: Where is Earth from the pole?
purpose: Teach that Earth hangs low on the polar horizon, can set for days, and that high peaks keep it in view more; Chapter 1's link cutoff is a drill.

beats.sub: Earth was already below the horizon

captions: From the south pole, Earth never climbs high. It hugs the horizon.
Through April {year} it rocks slowly up above the edge, then down below it.
From {set_day} to {rise_day}, Earth is below the horizon: no direct radio link.
Chapter 1's night falls inside that gap.
On the best peak near the pole, Earth is in view {dte}% of the time.
The same peak gets sunlight {sun_pct}% of the time.
That is why relay stations go on high peaks.
So in the game, shift 4's link cutoff is a training drill.
ends_on: When Earth is out of view, no one can answer quickly. Your crew plans and decides on its own.
